derivation.inputs: teacher phase labels (per episode), SC5 anchor, K=10
derivation.output: set of step indices where a valid K10 corridor window starts

definition.step_t_is_corridor_active: step t is a valid K10 SC5 corridor start: the window [t, t+K-1] exists within the episode AND does not overlap release_safe, recovery_or_regrasp, or abstain_unsupported phases
definition.relation_to_phase: corridor_active is STRICTER than stable_carry phase alone. It requires a full K10 window free of exclusion phases.

note: This field was MISSING in teacher_labels_fold00_combined500.jsonl (V1 label builder only wrote phase labels). V2 training script computes it at load time from phase labels using the frozen teacher protocol function. It is NOT stored as a pre-computed field in the JSONL.
